label: end-of-episode (last ~8 trials) unit, silenced by a1/S1 inputs
explanation: Fires essentially only in the last ~10 trials of the 100-trial episode: 99% of activation mass is at ep_trial 90-99 and it never fires before trial 80. The same steps are picked out by the model value head dropping below ~5.2 (value < 5.22 has recall 0.999), so the unit tracks the agent sense that the episode is ending. Magnitude grows toward the final trial: ep_trial >= 95 covers 84% of the top activation quartile but only 54% of the bottom one, and activations increase step by step across a window. Within that period it is suppressed by a1/S1-related inputs: almost zero at D2 steps whose in_action is a1 or in_state is S1. It is stronger when the agent is about to choose a2 (choice logit negative, action == 2 holds 87% of the mass) and when good == S2. Restricting to choice < 0 at GO/D2 raises dev F1 from 0.60 to 0.64. It does not fire at all in early or mid-episode trials, whatever the reward or transition history. Dev: precision 0.45, recall 0.90, F1 0.60, mass recall 0.95. Precision is limited because many late-episode steps (especially a1-committed sequences) stay silent. Uses only observed or internal variables.
